_comment: PUT_CARDS_BOTTOM_FLAG was set by nothing, and it gated BOTH the ability and the draw -- so the whole card was dead. 'You MAY put a card ... If you do, draw' is a MAY block: declining runs nothing, which is what makes 'if you do' fall out without needing a flag at all. Gated on the arsenal actually holding a card, so an empty arsenal cannot accept the prompt and draw for free.

effects.prompt: Put a card from your arsenal on the bottom of your deck to draw a card?
